title: 第9章 内衣在不在又能怎样？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    太快了。

    许默左臂完全发麻，根本来不及回防。

    嗖——噗嗤！

    一支利箭从许默的耳畔呼啸而过，狠狠扎进那头腾空野狼的眼窝！

    污血夹杂着脑浆瞬间炸开。

    那只狼在半空中失去了所有力气，砸在许默身旁，抽搐了两下便没了动静。

    就在这电光火石之间，撞在盾牌上的头狼也落地借力，再次扬起利爪。

    许默眼中暴虐，借着退后的冲力稳住下盘，右手的战术手斧抡出狠辣的半圆，对准头狼最脆弱的腰腹全力劈下。

    狼这种生物，铜头铁骨豆腐腰。

    利刃毫无阻碍地切开皮肉，狠狠剁碎了头狼的腰椎骨。

    凄厉的哀嚎声响彻林间，头狼的后半截身子瞬间瘫软，拖拽着内脏在地上疯狂翻滚。

    就在许默准备补刀的瞬间。

    第三只狼已经极其狡猾地避开了正面的锋芒，四肢几乎贴着地面滑行，改变轨迹，张开血盆大口扑向正在摸箭的方芸！

    距离太近，方芸根本来不及搭箭。

    “滚开！”

    许默发出一声野兽般的咆哮，不顾左臂的酸麻，蛮牛般合身扑上。

    他用尽全身力气，将那个满是抓痕的垃圾桶盖边缘，狠狠砸向那只狼的后腿关节。

    砰的一声闷响。

    那只狼在半空中失去了平衡，被许默这不顾一切的撞击直接砸飞出去，狠狠撞在旁边的一棵树干上。

    方芸的动作没有丝毫停顿，在野狼落地的同一秒，第三支箭矢已经离弦。

    箭簇深深没入野狼的脖颈。

    野狼痛嚎着试图挣扎起身，许默早已大步跨上，双手紧握沾满血肉的手斧，对着那颗狰狞的狼头重重劈下。

    骨骼碎裂的声音在死寂的林地里尤为刺耳。

    战斗爆发得极其突然，结束得也如疾风骤雨。

    从四狼围杀到遍地狼尸，整个过程甚至没有超过三十秒。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Too fast.

Xu Mo’s left arm was completely numb and he had no time to return to defense.

Whoosh—puff!

A sharp arrow whizzed past Xu Mo's ear and pierced the eye socket of the soaring wild wolf!

Dirty blood mixed with brain matter exploded instantly.

The wolf lost all its strength in mid-air and fell next to Xu Mo. It twitched twice and then stopped moving.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​…

Xu Mo's eyes were violent, and he used the momentum of his retreat to stabilize his lower body. He swung out a vicious semicircle with the tactical ax in his right hand, aiming at the most vulnerable waist and abdomen of the alpha wolf and slashing down with all his strength.

A creature like a wolf has a copper head, iron bones, and tofu waist.

The sharp blade cut through the flesh without any hindrance, and severely chopped into pieces the lumbar vertebrae of the wolf.

The shrill wail resounded through the forest, and the rear half of the alpha wolf's body instantly went limp, dragging its internal organs and rolling crazily on the ground.

The moment Xu Mo was about to make a last-ditch attack.

The third wolf has extremely cunningly avoided the frontal sharp edge. Its limbs are almost sliding on the ground, changing its trajectory, opening its bloody mouth and pounced on Fang Yun who was touching the arrow!

The distance was too close, and Fang Yun had no time to nock an arrow.

"Get out of here!"

Xu Mo let out a beast-like roar, ignoring the soreness in his left arm, and pounced on him like a bull.

He used all his strength to smash the scratched edge of the trash can lid against the wolf's hind leg joint.

There was a muffled bang.

The wolf lost its balance in mid-air and was sent flying by Xu Mo's desperate impact, slamming into a nearby tree trunk.

Fang Yun's movements did not pause at all. At the same second as the wild wolf landed, the third arrow had already left the string.

The arrow cluster penetrated deeply into the wild wolf's neck.

The wild wolf howled in pain and tried to struggle to get up. Xu Mo had already strode up, holding the flesh-stained hand ax tightly with both hands, and slashed hard at the ferocious wolf's head.

The sound of broken bones was particularly harsh in the dead forest.

The battle broke out suddenly and ended like a whirlwind.

The whole process from the four wolves surrounding and killing them to the wolf corpses everywhere didn’t even take more than thirty seconds.
